column1: # The model and licence of each fixture family, for the dataset README. Where `fixture fetch` reads a family's files from (repo, quant,
# revision) is the fixture table in crates/model/src/bin/fixture.rs (SPECS) and is not copied here. Every family that
# tools/refset-publish.sh publishes needs a row; the family names are the architectures of crates/refset/src/fixture.rs DIRS.
# The licence text is the base model's LICENSE file at a fixed revision, copied with its line ends as LF into
# tools/refset-publish/licences/<arch>.txt and published as LICENCES/<arch>.txt; the sha256 column is that file's, and the
# script refuses a copy that differs. Each licence permits redistribution on the condition that its notice goes with
# every copy, which the published LICENCES/ directory carries.
# arch<TAB>model<TAB>licence<TAB>licence text (the base model's LICENSE at a revision)<TAB>sha256 of the copy
